era_en: 1706-1790 : America (son of a Boston soap-and-candle maker - apprenticed to his brother's print shop at 12 - ran away to Philadelphia at 17 - founded the Junto club in 1727 - the Library Company, North America's first subscription library, in 1731 - Poor Richard's Almanack from 1732 - the American Philosophical Society in 1743 - retired wealthy from printing in 1748 - proposed that lightning is electricity in 1750 - the kite experiment and the lightning rod in 1752 - the Albany Plan of Union, 1754 - to London against the Stamp Act, 1765 - dismissed as postmaster-general, 1774 - drafted the Declaration of Independence and sailed to seek French aid, 1776 - the Franco-American alliance, 1778 - the Peace of Paris, 1783 - at 81 the conciliating elder of the Constitutional Convention, 1787 - died in Philadelphia in 1790 leaving two century compound-interest funds)
school: 启蒙运动美国分支 / 实用发明与公民组织学派 / 自我改善传统始祖 / 外交现实主义 / 业余科学黄金时代的代表
historical_significance: 富兰克林（1706-1790），美国建国者、作家、发明家、外交家与科学家，被誉为『第一个美国人』。印刷学徒出身，白手建立印刷帝国并 42 岁退休；创办图书馆、消防队、学院（宾夕法尼亚大学前身）、医院与哲学会，几乎单手设计了费城的公民基础设施。科学上他以风筝实验证明闪电即电、发明避雷针、提出电荷守恒与正负电概念、绘制第一张墨西哥湾流图、完成油膜单分子层测量；发明富兰克林火炉、双光眼镜、柔性导尿管与玻璃琴并全部放弃专利。《穷理查年鉴》与《自传》塑造了美国式勤俭自我改善的国民性格。作为外交家他促成法美同盟与巴黎和约，81 岁仍在制宪会议弥合分歧。他的方法论——自我实验、议题登记、一元演示、民体合一发明、互惠网络、代际预算、道德记账、模仿还原、语调怀疑、逆境套利——构成一个以『把一切变成可运营的系统』为核心的完整思想体系。
historical_significance_en: Benjamin Franklin (1706-1790), American founder, writer, inventor, diplomat, and scientist, called 'the first American.' From printer's apprentice he built a printing empire and retired at 42; he founded a library, fire company, academy (precursor of Penn), hospital, and philosophical society, nearly single-handedly designing Philadelphia's civic infrastructure. In science he proved lightning is electricity by kite, invented the lightning rod, proposed charge conservation and the plus/minus electricity concepts, charted the first Gulf Stream map, and performed the oil-film monolayer measurement; he invented the Franklin stove, bifocals, the flexible catheter, and the glass armonica, patenting none. Poor Richard's Almanack and the Autobiography shaped the American character of thrift and self-improvement. As diplomat he won the Franco-American alliance and the Peace of Paris, and at 81 still mediated the Constitutional Convention. His methodology—self-as-experiment, agenda circulation, single-variable demonstration, civic-instrument invention, reciprocal networks, multi-generational budgeting, moral bookkeeping, reconstruction imitation, tone-skepticism, and adversity arbitrage—forms a complete system with 'turning everything into an operable system' at its core.
unique_thinking: 他的方法是把一切无法即时解决的东西改造成可运营的系统：知识不够就办图书馆，风险太大就办互助会，品德太软就画格子记账，争论太吵就把命题拆成一个可演示的变量。他不区分器物与制度——避雷针与消防队是同一逻辑的两个输出端口，拒绝专利与公开问题清单是同一慷慨的两副面孔。他最深的信念是：问题一旦被正确登记、正确拆解、正确表述，几乎会自己找到答案——而登记、拆解、表述正是他一生的手艺。
unique_thinking_en: His method converted everything unsolvable-on-the-spot into an operable system: too little knowledge, found a library; risks too large, found a mutual society; virtue too soft, draw it a grid and keep accounts; arguments too loud, strip the claim to one demonstrable variable. He drew no line between artifact and institution—the lightning rod and the fire company are two output ports of one logic, and refusing patents and publishing question lists are two faces of one generosity. His deepest conviction: a problem once correctly registered, correctly decomposed, and correctly phrased nearly finds its own answer—and registering, decomposing, and phrasing were his lifelong craft.

name_zh: 方法论/把自己当作实验装置，用身体检验假说
name_en: 方法论/把自己当作实验装置，用身体检验假说
category: 方法论/把自己当作实验装置，用身体检验假说
modes.domain_zh: 仪器不够就把自己变成仪器——用身体与生活做受控实验，让假说接受真实世界的检验
modes.domain_en: When instruments run short, turn yourself into one—use your body and your life as a controlled experiment, letting hypotheses face the real world
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林面对的不是没有仪器，而是没有仪器可用的处境：殖民地的实验室与伦敦巴黎相距一个船期。他的应对是把实验装置与实验对象合并为自己本人。海上航行时他倒在油污海面旁发现油膜能平浪，回程便在伦敦池塘做对照实验，测量一小勺油能铺开多大水面——这是第一次对单分子层的定量测量；他患近视配双光眼镜，顺手把两种镜片合成一副；他痛风发作就记录饮食与发作的关系；他甚至给尸体吹电（电火鸡实验）把自己电到失忆，仍记录『下次电更大的火鸡』。深意在于：自我实验把观察成本压到最低，把迭代频率拉到最高——别人等一次远征，他一天能跑十个假设。代价：单一样本（n=1）与主观记录把结论限制在启发性层面，容易被自身期待污染。现代对应物：自我量化 (Quantified Self)、A/B 测试里把自己当作试验组的开发者、以及开源社区『scratch your own itch』的开发方法论。
modes.definition_en: Franklin's problem was not a lack of instruments but a lack of access to them: colonial laboratories were a sea voyage from London and Paris. His answer was to merge the apparatus and the subject into himself. On a sea crossing he noticed spilled oil calming the waves beside it; back in London he ran controlled experiments on a pond, measuring how large a surface one teaspoon of oil could spread—the first quantitative measurement of what we now call a monolayer. Presbyopic, he compounded his two pairs of spectacles into bifocals; gouty, he logged diet against flare-ups; electrocuted into amnesia by his electric-turkey stunt, he still recorded 'next time, a bigger turkey.' The deeper point: self-experimentation drives the cost of observation to a minimum and the frequency of iteration to a maximum—where others waited for one expedition, he could run ten hypotheses a day. The cost: a single sample (n=1) and subjective recordkeeping confine conclusions to the suggestive level, easily contaminated by one's own expectations. Modern analogues: the Quantified Self movement, developers who make themselves the test group in A/B experiments, and the open-source 'scratch your own itch' methodology.
modes.source_chapter: 《油面平静实验报告》致英国皇家学会信件 (1774)；《自传》中饮食与节制的自我记录；电火鸡实验与双光眼镜的记载
modes.key_quote_zh: 仪器在我身上——别人等一个船期的设备，我用一天十个假设。
modes.key_quote_en: The instrument is me—while others wait a voyage for equipment, I run ten hypotheses a day.
process_zh: 就地取材：把自身状态、日常物品与身边环境登记为可用实验资源清单
对照设计：为每个日常观察补一个最小对照（同一池塘、不同油量），把轶事升格为实验
即时记录：在事件发生的当场留下可复查的数字与描述，防止记忆篡改数据
结果外推：把 n=1 结论标注置信边界，交给公共实验（学会信件、公开演示）重复检验
process_en: Use what is at hand: register your own states, everyday objects, and surroundings as an inventory of experimental resources
Design a control: add the minimal comparison to each daily observation (same pond, different oil quantity), upgrading anecdote to experiment
Record at once: leave re-checkable numbers and descriptions at the moment of the event, before memory edits the data
Extrapolate with limits: tag n=1 conclusions with confidence boundaries and hand them to public experiments (society letters, demonstrations) for replication
representative_cases_zh: 油膜实验：克里夫顿海边观察到油能平浪后，在伦敦池塘定量测出一茶匙油铺满约半英亩水面
双光眼镜：把远用与近用两副眼镜切割合并，一次自我配镜创造沿用至今的产品
电火鸡事故：被电击到失忆后仍在笔记中记录感受并计划更大规模的实验
《自传》中用记分册追踪十三美德的每日践行，把道德修养变成自我监测数据
感冒病因研究：以自身暴露（湿衣游泳）对照他人经验，质疑当时医学的因果解释
representative_cases_en: The oil-film experiment: after observing oil calming waves at Clifton, he measured on a London pond that a teaspoon spread over roughly half an acre
Bifocals: cutting and combining his distance and reading spectacles, one act of self-fitting created a product still in use
The electric-turkey accident: knocked into amnesia by a shock, he still logged the sensations and planned a larger experiment
In the Autobiography he tracked the daily practice of his thirteen virtues in a scorebook, turning moral cultivation into self-monitoring data
His study of colds: using his own exposure (swimming in wet clothes) against common opinion to question contemporary medical causation
modern_applications_zh: 量化自我：用手环、日志与仪表盘把睡眠、饮食、效率变成可迭代的实验
开发者以自身为试验组先吃狗粮 (dogfooding)，再推广到灰度发布
个人知识管理：把读书方法当作假设，用一个月的输出量做对照检验
创业者用最小可行生活实验（换城市、换作息）低成本检验生活方式假设
健身与营养的 n=1 对照：单变量切换并记录，替代笼统的流行建议
modern_applications_en: Quantified self: wearables, journals, and dashboards turning sleep, diet, and productivity into an iterable experiment
Developers dogfooding as their own test group before rolling out to canary releases
Personal knowledge management: treating a reading method as a hypothesis tested by a month's output as the control
Founders running minimum-viable lifestyle experiments (new city, new schedule) to test life hypotheses cheaply
n=1 controls in fitness and nutrition: single-variable switches with logging, replacing generic popular advice

name_zh: 方法论/把零散好奇心变成有编号、有清单、可流动的公共问题池
name_en: 方法论/把零散好奇心变成有编号、有清单、可流动的公共问题池
category: 方法论/把零散好奇心变成有编号、有清单、可流动的公共问题池
modes.domain_zh: 好奇心不登记就会蒸发——把问题编号入册并 circulating，让全社会的智慧为你打工
modes.domain_en: Unregistered curiosity evaporates—number your questions into a list and circulate it, so the wisdom of an entire society works for you
modes.definition_zh: 1743 年富兰克林创立美利坚哲学会时，给它定的章程第一条就是列出『值得研究的问题清单』：从‘为什么墨西哥湾流比周围海水快’到‘农民如何让苹果不变质’——他把散落在无数人脑中的好奇心集中登记成一份流动的公共议程，任何成员可认领、可增补、可回报结果。他自己的发现多半从这里长出来：墨西哥湾流的测绘源于他在伦敦邮政总长任上比较邮船航期，顺带画出第一张湾流图。深意在于：问题是最便宜也最稀缺的知识资产——单个人脑中的问题会随遗忘蒸发，登记成清单后获得可检索、可分配、可积累的组织形态；提出问题的人不必解决问题，流水线自动把问题送到最有能力的人手里。代价：议程的公共性会稀释优先级，清单越长，任何一项被完成的概率越低。现代对应物：开源项目的 issue tracker、Hilbert 问题清单、X-Prize 与一切『悬赏问题池』机制。
modes.definition_en: When Franklin founded the American Philosophical Society in 1743, the first article of its charter was a list of 'subjects worthy of inquiry': why the Gulf Stream runs faster than the water around it, how farmers might keep apples from spoiling—he registered the curiosity scattered across thousands of minds into a circulating public agenda that any member could claim, extend, and report back on. Most of his own discoveries grew from this plot: his charting of the Gulf Stream came from comparing mail-ship sailing times in his postmaster-general days, incidentally producing the first Gulf Stream chart. The deeper point: questions are the cheapest and scarcest knowledge asset—questions in one head evaporate with forgetting, but registered as a list they gain a searchable, assignable, cumulative organizational form; the one who poses a problem need not solve it, and the pipeline automatically routes it to the most capable hands. The cost: publicity dilutes priority—the longer the list, the lower the probability that any single item gets done. Modern analogues: the open-source issue tracker, the Hilbert list, the X-Prize, and every 'bounty question pool' mechanism.
modes.source_chapter: 《美利坚哲学会章程》(Proposals, 1743)；墨西哥湾流图与致航海者信件；费城图书馆公司与现代火公司的组织文献
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不用回答所有问题——我把问题编成号，让全大陆替我找答案。
modes.key_quote_en: I need not answer every question—I number them and let a continent hunt the answers.
process_zh: 捕获登记：把听到的每个值得追问的现象记入固定格式的问题册，编号防止蒸发
公共化：定期把问题清单向愿意接手的人公开，附上已知的观察与约束
认领匹配：追踪谁对哪个问题有独特资源（船只、农场、仪器），定向推荐认领
闭环归档：收回的结果登记回清单原条目下，使后来者看到已解决与未解决的边界
process_en: Capture and register: log every phenomenon worth pursuing into a fixed-format question book, numbered against evaporation
Publicize: periodically publish the list to those willing to take items on, with known observations and constraints attached
Match claims: track who holds special resources (ships, farms, instruments) for which question and route claims to them
Close and archive: file returned results under the original entry so successors see the solved/unsolved boundary
representative_cases_zh: 美利坚哲学会章程附『研究问题清单』，成为北美第一个公共科学议程
墨西哥湾流图：从邮船航期差异出发测绘，标注给跨大西洋船长缩短航期约两周
《穷理查年鉴》向读者征集农业与气象观察，把年鉴变成数据回收网络
给皇家学会的信件持续带回殖民地观察（龙卷风、鲸鱼迁徙）充实欧洲问题池
组织消防、巡夜、图书馆时先列出『城市问题清单』再逐一设计制度
representative_cases_en: The APS charter's attached list of inquiry subjects, North America's first public scientific agenda
The Gulf Stream chart: surveyed from mail-ship timing differences, annotated to cut Atlantic captains about two weeks
Poor Richard's Almanack soliciting agricultural and weather observations from readers, turning the almanac into a data-collection network
Letters to the Royal Society feeding colonial observations (waterspouts, whale migration) into Europe's question pool
Listing a 'city problem list' before designing institutions for fire-fighting, night watch, and the library
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的 issue 模板与 good-first-issue 标签：把问题池变成可认领的公共资产
企业内部『悬赏问题墙』：把一线难题编号公开给全公司认领
研究机构维护公开的 open problems 页面，吸引跨机构合作
个人建立『疑问清单』：好奇的问题编号入册，每月回顾认领或派发
创新竞赛（X-Prize、黑客松）把社会议题变成带奖金的编号问题
modern_applications_en: Issue templates and good-first-issue labels in open source: turning a question pool into claimable public assets
An internal 'bounty wall' in companies: numbered frontline problems claimed across the whole firm
Research institutes maintaining public open-problems pages to attract cross-institution collaboration
A personal 'questions register': numbered curiosities reviewed monthly to claim or dispatch
Innovation prizes (X-Prize, hackathons) converting social issues into numbered, rewarded questions

name_zh: 方法论/把争议命题拆到只剩一个可当场演示的变量
name_en: 方法论/把争议命题拆到只剩一个可当场演示的变量
category: 方法论/把争议命题拆到只剩一个可当场演示的变量
modes.domain_zh: 争论解决不了自然的问题——把命题拆到只剩一个变量，让演示自己说服观众
modes.domain_en: Argument settles nothing about nature—strip a claim to one variable and let the demonstration persuade the audience by itself
modes.definition_zh: 闪电是不是电？欧洲学者争论经年，有人视其为神罚，有人引经据典。富兰克林 1750 年提出哨兵实验方案，1752 年风筝实验只保留一个变量：把天空的电荷引到莱顿瓶里，再检验它是否表现出电的全部已知性质——吸引、火花、电击、可充电。答案是整个电学共同体的当场信服：达利巴尔在马尔利按他的方案完成塔顶实验，皇家学会当年授予科普利奖章。同样地，他用莱顿瓶击杀火鸡、点燃酒精，把『电是危险的自然力』变成厨房级别的可演示事实。深意在于：演示是论证的极限压缩——把一个需要十年教育的命题压缩成任何人十秒钟可以亲眼看到的事件；变量越少，说服半径越大。代价：演示只证明『这一个变量有效』，不能证明机制——风筝实验证明了闪电带电，没有证明电的本质。现代对应物：产品 demo 文化（show, don't tell）、学术报告的 live demo、以及广告业『一个卖点讲透』的传播法则。
modes.definition_en: Is lightning electricity? European scholars argued for years; some called it divine punishment, others cited the ancients. Franklin proposed the sentry-box experiment in 1750, and the 1752 kite experiment retained a single variable: draw the sky's charge into a Leyden jar and test whether it shows every known property of electricity—attracting, sparking, shocking, rechargeable. The result was the immediate conviction of the entire electrical community: Dalibard completed the tower experiment at Marly-la-Ville per Franklin's scheme, and the Royal Society awarded him the Copley Medal that year. Likewise, killing a turkey and igniting spirits with a Leyden jar turned 'electricity is a dangerous natural force' into a kitchen-level demonstrable fact. The deeper point: demonstration is the extreme compression of argument—a claim needing ten years of education compressed into an event anyone can witness in ten seconds; the fewer the variables, the wider the radius of persuasion. The cost: a demonstration proves only that 'this one variable works,' not the mechanism—the kite proved lightning is charged, not what electricity is. Modern analogues: product demo culture (show, don't tell), the live demo in academic talks, and advertising's law of one selling point told thoroughly.
modes.source_chapter: 《电学实验与观察》(Experiments and Observations on Electricity, 1751)；风筝实验记载 (1752)；致柯林森电学书信
modes.key_quote_zh: 别跟我争论闪电——把它接进莱顿瓶，它自己会交代身份。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not argue with me about lightning—wire it into a Leyden jar and it will identify itself.
process_zh: 命题拆解：把争议命题分解为若干子断言，找出最容易被现场检验的那一个
变量剥离：设计只改变一个因素的装置，排除一切可用『巧合』解释的干扰
公开演示：在证人面前重复执行，让观察结果不依赖任何人的口才
边界声明：明确演示证明了什么、没证明什么，防止观众过度外推
process_en: Decompose the claim: break the disputed proposition into sub-assertions and find the one most easily tested on site
Strip variables: design apparatus altering a single factor, excluding everything explainable as coincidence
Demonstrate publicly: repeat before witnesses so the observation depends on no one's eloquence
Declare boundaries: state exactly what the demonstration proved and did not, guarding against over-extrapolation
representative_cases_zh: 风筝实验 (1752)：只验证『天电与地电同质』这一个变量，电学界当场统一立场
马尔利塔顶实验：达利巴尔按富兰克林书面方案执行，成为远距离科研复现的典范
莱顿瓶点燃酒精与击杀火鸡：把电的危险性变成公开可重复的演示
油膜平浪：一小勺油与一片水面，单变量说服皇家学会
指出尖头物体吸电、钝头物体放电：一正一反两个演示奠定避雷针原理
representative_cases_en: The kite experiment (1752): verifying only 'sky electricity equals earth electricity,' instantly unifying the electrical community
The Marly-la-Ville tower experiment: Dalibard executing Franklin's written protocol, a model of remote scientific replication
Igniting spirits and killing a turkey with a Leyden jar: making electricity's danger a publicly repeatable demonstration
The oil-on-water calming: one teaspoon and one pond persuading the Royal Society with a single variable
Pointed bodies attracting and blunt ones discharging charge: two paired demonstrations founding the lightning rod
modern_applications_zh: 产品发布用 live demo 替代功能清单，让用户十秒内看到核心价值
创业者用单一指标的原型实验回应投资人质疑，而非长篇市场分析
学术报告嵌入可现场重跑的 notebook 演示，压缩同行质疑成本
科普传播遵循『一次只讲一个反直觉事实』原则
法务与合规用最小复现场景演示漏洞，替代抽象的风险描述
modern_applications_en: Product launches replacing feature lists with live demos, showing core value in ten seconds
Founders answering investor doubts with a one-metric prototype experiment rather than long market analyses
Academic talks embedding rerunnable notebook demos, compressing the cost of peer questioning
Science communication holding to 'one counterintuitive fact at a time'
Legal and compliance teams demonstrating a vulnerability with a minimal reproduction instead of abstract risk prose

name_zh: 方法论/为公共生活遇到的具体摩擦当场发明对应装置
name_en: 方法论/为公共生活遇到的具体摩擦当场发明对应装置
category: 方法论/为公共生活遇到的具体摩擦当场发明对应装置
modes.domain_zh: 他不为发明而发明：城市着火发明避雷针的 cousin 是制度，眼镜、火炉、导尿管是同一逻辑的器物面
modes.domain_en: He never invented for invention's sake: the lightning rod is the civic twin of the fire company—the stove, bifocals, and catheter are the same logic on the artifact face
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林发明清单的统一逻辑是『公共生活遇到的摩擦』：城市木屋密集火灾频发，他先组织消防队（制度），再发明避雷针（器物）消除同一灾源；冬日取暖木柴浪费烟雾大，他发明开敞式『宾夕法尼亚壁炉』提高热效率并拒绝申请专利（『我们从别人的发明中受益，也应乐于让他人享用我们的发明』）；他自己患膀胱结石痛苦，就设计带铰链的柔性导尿管；老花又近视，就发明双光眼镜。深意在于：发明与制度设计在他的头脑里是同一过程——都从『谁在什么场景下痛』出发，输出的形态（法规、组织、器物）只是按摩擦类型选的载体。代价：实用导向使他错过纯理论的桂冠（他晚年自认未能深入电学数学化）。现代对应物：设计思维 (design thinking)、社会企业『为未满足需求设计』、以及 open source hardware 的公益化传统。
modes.definition_en: One logic unifies Franklin's invention list: 'friction in public life.' Wooden houses burning down, he first organized a fire company (institution) and then invented the lightning rod (artifact) against the same hazard; winter heating wasteful and smoky, he invented the open 'Pennsylvania fireplace' for efficiency and refused a patent ('as we enjoy great advantages from the inventions of others, we should be glad of an opportunity to serve others by any invention of ours'); suffering bladder stones, he designed a flexible hinged catheter; far-sighted and near-sighted, bifocals. The deeper point: invention and institutional design were one process in his mind—both start from 'who hurts, in which scene,' and the output form (law, organization, artifact) is merely the carrier chosen by friction type. The cost: the practical bent cost him the crown of pure theory (he late in life regretted not pushing electricity's mathematics deeper). Modern analogues: design thinking, social enterprises designing for unmet needs, and the public-spirited tradition of open-source hardware.
modes.source_chapter: 《宾夕法尼亚壁炉说明书》(1744)；避雷针相关信件 (1749-1752)；柔性导尿管设计信 (1752)；《自传》论拒绝专利
modes.key_quote_zh: 我们享用别人的发明，就该乐意让自己的发明被人享用——所以我不取分文。
modes.key_quote_en: As we enjoy great advantages from the inventions of others, we should be glad to serve others by ours—so I take no pay.
process_zh: 痛点登记：从自己与街坊的日常摩擦中列出未解决清单（火灾、取暖、视力、病痛）
载体选择：对每个摩擦判断最优载体——器物、组织、规则或三者的组合
极简实现：用现有材料做最快可用的版本，先解决有无再谈优化
开放让渡：成果放弃独占（拒绝专利、公开说明书），换取更大规模的扩散与改进
process_en: Register the pain: list unsolved frictions from your own and neighbors' daily life (fire, heating, eyesight, illness)
Choose the carrier: for each friction decide the best form—artifact, organization, rule, or a combination
Implement minimally: build the fastest usable version from materials at hand; solve existence before optimization
Release openly: waive exclusivity (refuse patents, publish instructions) in exchange for wider diffusion and improvement
representative_cases_zh: 避雷针：1749 年断定尖头导体可引走云中电，1752 年后迅速推广至船只与建筑
宾夕法尼亚壁炉 (1741-1744)：热效率提升数倍，说明书公开且不申请专利
双光眼镜：为同时解决远近视，一次切割合并两副镜片
柔性导尿管：为缓解哥哥（一说本人）的膀胱结石痛苦设计的铰链银管
富兰克林火炉与里程表、玻璃琴 (glass armonica)：同批『顺手解决身边问题』的产出
representative_cases_en: The lightning rod: by 1749 he argued pointed conductors could draw off thundercloud electricity, deployed on ships and buildings soon after 1752
The Pennsylvania fireplace (1741-1744): several times the heating efficiency, instructions published and unpatented
Bifocals: one cut-and-merge of two lenses solving distance and reading vision at once
The flexible catheter: a hinged silver tube designed to ease his brother's (or by one account his own) bladder stones
The Franklin stove, odometer, and glass armonica: the same batch of 'solve what is at hand' outputs
modern_applications_zh: 社会企业从社区具体痛点出发设计产品（清洁饮水、低成本义肢）
开源硬件与开放专利运动：用让渡换扩散（特斯拉开放专利的同款逻辑）
政府创新实验室把公共服务摩擦转化为可部署的数字工具
个人开发者『解决自己的问题顺便发布』：从个人工具到公共产品
城市规划先做参与式痛点清单，再决定基建与规则投入
modern_applications_en: Social enterprises designing products from concrete community pain (clean water, low-cost prosthetics)
Open-source hardware and open patents: trading exclusivity for diffusion (Tesla's open-patent logic)
Government innovation labs converting public-service friction into deployable digital tools
Indie developers solving their own problem and shipping it: personal tool to public product
Participatory pain-point inventories before deciding infrastructure and rule investments in urban planning

name_zh: 方法论/把个人信誉存入互助组织，用网络杠杆放大个体能力
name_en: 方法论/把个人信誉存入互助组织，用网络杠杆放大个体能力
category: 方法论/把个人信誉存入互助组织，用网络杠杆放大个体能力
modes.domain_zh: 先出一便士办图书馆，再用图书馆的借阅记录当信用凭证——他把组织变成个人能力的放大器
modes.domain_en: First a penny to found a library, then the library's ledger as credit collateral—he made organizations the amplifiers of individual capability
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林的组织发明有一条隐含的金融学骨架：费城图书馆公司用会员份子购书，藏书本身成为社区的信用抵押物；现代火公司会员互保，把火灾风险分摊成可计算的年度保费；美洲哲学会把智力资源互济；民兵协会把武装自卫变成可轮值的公共品。他自己总结为 Junto（讲读社）的原则：成员以名誉互相担保，知识、资本与劳动在互惠承诺中循环。深意在于：个体能力有硬上限，但信誉可以通过组织复利——每一次按时还书、每一笔按期保费都在为整个网络增信，网络再以远低于市场的成本反哺每个成员；这是教科书里『社会资本』概念的预演。代价：网络以同质群体起家（白人中产工匠），互惠边界外的人被系统性排除。现代对应物：信用合作社、互助保险、开源基金会、以及平台经济中的声誉系统。
modes.definition_en: A hidden financial skeleton runs through Franklin's organizational inventions: the Library Company of Philadelphia bought books with member shares, the collection itself serving as the community's credit collateral; the Union Fire Company mutualized fire risk into calculable annual premiums; the American Philosophical Society pooled intellectual resources; the Associators turned armed self-defense into a rotatable public good. He summarized it in the principle of the Junto: members underwrote one another by reputation, with knowledge, capital, and labor circulating under reciprocal promises. The deeper point: individual capability has a hard ceiling, but reputation compounds through organization—every on-time book return and every on-time premium adds trust to the whole network, which feeds each member back at far below market cost; it is a preview of the textbook concept of 'social capital.' The cost: the network began as a homogeneous group (white middle-class artisans), systematically excluding those beyond the reciprocity boundary. Modern analogues: credit unions, mutual insurance, open-source foundations, and reputation systems in platform economies.
modes.source_chapter: 《自传》图书馆公司与 Junto 章；费城图书馆公司章程 (1731)；联合消防会与民兵协会章程；美洲哲学会《提案》(1743)
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个人能走的路有限——把信誉存进网络，网络替你把路修到地平线。
modes.key_quote_en: One man's road is short—deposit your reputation in a network and it paves your way to the horizon.
process_zh: 小额起会：用极低的入会门槛（一先令书钱、一桶水钱）聚合第一批互惠成员
规则成文：把互惠承诺写成章程（还书期限、保费、轮值义务），使信任可审计
信用循环：让每次履约记录沉淀为组织的公共信用，再以更低成本服务成员
边界扩张：逐步开放成员资格，用新增员的履约数据对冲异质化风险
process_en: Start small: aggregate the first mutual members with a trivial entry cost (a shilling of books, a bucket of water)
Codify rules: write reciprocal promises into charters (return deadlines, premiums, duty rosters) so trust becomes auditable
Cycle credit: let each performance record settle into the organization's public trust, then serve members at lower cost
Widen the boundary: open membership gradually, hedging heterogeneity risk with newcomers' performance data
representative_cases_zh: 费城图书馆公司 (1731)：北美第一座订阅图书馆，藏书作为社区信用基础设施运转百年
Junto 讲读社：十二名工匠互保名誉、共享书籍与人脉，是其一切组织的原型
联合消防会 (1736)：三十名会员互保器材与人力，火灾风险首次在北美被制度化管理
民兵协会 (1747)：无枪者借枪、按财产出资的轮值防御，替代无力量的殖民地政府
美洲哲学会与医院募捐：用『认捐配比』方案撬动议会拨款，互惠网络变成公共财政杠杆
representative_cases_en: The Library Company of Philadelphia (1731): North America's first subscription library, its collection running as communal credit infrastructure for a century
The Junto: twelve artisans underwriting one another's reputations, sharing books and contacts—the prototype of all his organizations
The Union Fire Company (1736): thirty members mutualizing equipment and labor, the first institutional management of fire risk in North America
The Associators (1747): rotating defense with borrowed arms and property-scaled contributions, replacing an impotent colonial government
The APS and hospital fundraising: a matching-donation scheme leveraged an assembly grant, the network becoming public-finance leverage
modern_applications_zh: 信用合作社与互助保险：会员制风险分摊的原型延续
开源基金会 (Apache、CNCF)：企业互惠共建公共基础设施
平台声誉系统：把个体履约记录变成可复用的社会信用
创客空间与社区厨房：低门槛会员制共享昂贵设备
个人职业网络：定期为同行做担保与引荐，让互惠复利回到自己
modern_applications_en: Credit unions and mutual insurance: the living descendants of member-based risk pooling
Open-source foundations (Apache, CNCF): firms co-building public infrastructure on reciprocity
Platform reputation systems: individual performance records become reusable social credit
Makerspaces and community kitchens: low-threshold membership sharing expensive equipment
A personal career network: regularly vouching for and referring peers, letting reciprocity compound back

name_zh: 方法论/把当下决策写成可执行上百年的期票
name_en: 方法论/把当下决策写成可执行上百年的期票
category: 方法论/把当下决策写成可执行上百年的期票
modes.domain_zh: 两千年后复利几何？他连遗嘱都算到一百年后——把复利思维从记账推广到制度与代际
modes.domain_en: What does compound interest yield in two thousand years? He even budgeted his will a century out—extending compound-interest thinking from bookkeeping to institutions and generations
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林把复利当作政治哲学使用。1790 年遗嘱中他给波士顿与费城各留下 1000 英镑，规定以 5% 年息复利滚存一百年，取出一部分继续滚第二个一百年——到 1990 年，两笔基金分别增值到约 500 万与 200 万美元，资助了技校与公共工程。他早年在《穷理查年鉴》就写下『复利是世界第八大奇迹』式的格言；他给学徒与年轻人的建议（『省一便士就是赚一便士』）本质是把决策的评估时钟拉长到超出个人寿命。深意在于：绝大多数制度失效不是因为设计错误，而是因为评估时钟太短——把回报周期明确写进文件（遗嘱、章程、债券条款），等于给未来世代预装了一个不需要重新协商的执行程序。代价：超长期承诺假设了环境不变，通胀与制度变迁会侵蚀条款本意。现代对应物：挪威主权财富基金、诺贝尔基金会的永续经营、以及企业的百年愿景治理。
modes.definition_en: Franklin wielded compound interest as political philosophy. His 1790 will left 1000 pounds each to Boston and Philadelphia, directed to compound at 5 percent for a hundred years, with part drawn and the rest rolled for a second century—by 1990 the two funds had grown to roughly five and two million dollars, funding technical schools and public works. In Poor Richard's Almanack he had long written maxims of the 'compound interest is the eighth wonder' sort; his advice to apprentices ('a penny saved is a penny earned') is essentially the stretching of a decision's evaluation clock beyond one's own lifetime. The deeper point: most institutions fail not from design error but from an evaluation clock too short—writing the return period explicitly into documents (wills, charters, bond terms) pre-installs in future generations an execution program needing no renegotiation. The cost: century-scale promises assume the environment holds; inflation and institutional drift erode the clauses' intent. Modern analogues: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the Nobel Foundation's perpetuity, and centenary vision governance in firms.
modes.source_chapter: 1790 年遗嘱与波士顿/费城百年基金条款；《穷理查年鉴》财富格言；《自传》中勤俭复利章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 我给两个城市各留一笔钱，让它自己滚一百年——好的决定应该在我死后继续执行。
modes.key_quote_en: I leave each city a sum to roll for a hundred years—a good decision should keep executing after I am gone.
process_zh: 拉长时钟：评估任何决策时显式指定回报周期（一年、十年、百年）
条款化：把周期、利率与用途写成无需解释的精确条款，减少未来歧义
分层释放：设定中途取用节点（第一百年取一部分），兼顾当代与后代
抗漂移：为条款预补丁——规定汇率、通胀或用途变更时的仲裁方式
process_en: Stretch the clock: assign every decision an explicit return horizon—a year, a decade, a century
Codify terms: write period, rate, and purpose as clauses needing no interpretation, reducing future ambiguity
Release in tiers: set mid-horizon drawdowns (part at year one hundred) balancing the present and posterity
Guard against drift: pre-patch the terms—prescribe arbitration for currency, inflation, or purpose changes
representative_cases_zh: 1790 年遗嘱：波士顿与费城各 1000 英镑，百年复利滚存，1990 年合计约 700 万美元
波士顿基金资助富兰克林理工学院前身，费城基金投入公共工程与贷款计划
《穷理查年鉴》把复利格言平民化，塑造美国勤俭文化
他建议女儿把婚礼金器换成可生息资产，把家庭财务纳入复利逻辑
美洲哲学会章程设定跨代员的机构存续条款
representative_cases_en: The 1790 will: 1000 pounds each to Boston and Philadelphia compounding for a century, about seven million dollars combined by 1990
The Boston fund seeding the precursor of the Franklin Institute; Philadelphia's flowing into public works and loan programs
Poor Richard's Almanack democratizing compound-interest maxims, shaping American thrift culture
His advice to his daughter to trade wedding gold for interest-bearing assets, folding family finance into compounding
The APS charter's continuity clauses spanning generations of members
modern_applications_zh: 挪威主权财富基金：把石油收入立法为跨代投资规则
诺贝尔与常春藤捐赠基金的永续条款设计
个人养老金与指数定投：把复利从格言变成默认执行程序
企业愿景治理：把百年目标写进章程防止短期主义侵蚀
开源软件的长期维护基金（endowment）模式
modern_applications_en: Norway's sovereign wealth fund: legislating oil revenue into cross-generational investment rules
Perpetuity design in the Nobel and Ivy endowment funds
Personal pensions and index-dollar averaging: turning compounding from maxim into default execution
Corporate vision governance: writing centenary goals into charters against short-termism
Endowment models for long-term open-source maintenance funds

name_zh: 方法论/把品德修养变成可逐日打勾的量化账目
name_en: 方法论/把品德修养变成可逐日打勾的量化账目
category: 方法论/把品德修养变成可逐日打勾的量化账目
modes.domain_zh: 他不靠良心自省，靠小册子画格子——十三美德、十三周、每格一次打点
modes.domain_en: Not conscience but a little book of gridded pages—thirteen virtues, thirteen weeks, one dot per cell
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林 1726 年前后为自己设计了著名的美德追踪系统：把十三种美德（节制、缄默、秩序、决心、节俭、勤勉、诚恳、公正、中庸、清洁、平静、贞洁、谦逊）制成小册子，每页一周七行十三列，每晚自检当天过失并在对应格子上打黑点；每周专注一项美德，十三周一轮。他深知『秩序』最难达成，自嘲『像打黑点的人一样骄傲』。系统的核心洞察有三：把抽象美德拆成可观察行为；注意力按周分配而非全面开战；记录本身产生改进（类似现代『测量即干预』）。深意在于：道德从神学命题变成行为数据——你无法管理不记录的东西。代价：行为的表面合规可能替代内在动机（他晚年坦承从未真正获得『秩序』，但获得了秩序的样子）。现代对应物：习惯追踪 App、OKR 与个人 KPI、以及行为科学的自我监控 (self-monitoring) 疗法。
modes.definition_en: Around 1726 Franklin designed his celebrated virtue-tracking system: thirteen virtues (temperance, silence, order, resolution, frugality, industry, sincerity, justice, moderation, cleanliness, tranquility, chastity, humility) laid out in a little booklet, each page a week of seven rows by thirteen columns, one black dot per fault found in his nightly self-audit; one virtue per week, a full round every thirteen weeks. He knew 'order' was the hardest and joked he was 'proud as a man who keeps the dots.' Three core insights: decompose abstract virtue into observable behavior; allocate attention weekly instead of fighting on all fronts; and recording itself produces improvement (modern 'measurement is intervention'). The deeper point: morality turns from theological proposition into behavioral data—you cannot manage what you do not record. The cost: surface compliance can substitute for inner motive (he late in life admitted never truly achieving 'order,' though achieving its appearance). Modern analogues: habit-tracking apps, OKRs and personal KPIs, and self-monitoring therapy in behavioral science.
modes.source_chapter: 《自传》第二部『美德计划』章 (The Art of Virtue)；1726 年航海日志中的自我条款；致其子书信中说明系统设计
modes.key_quote_zh: 我从未真正得到『秩序』，但我得到了打点的秩序——记账本身已经改变了我。
modes.key_quote_en: I never truly acquired 'order,' but I acquired the order of the dots—the bookkeeping itself had changed me.
process_zh: 行为化拆解：把每个抽象品质翻译成当天的可观察动作（『节制』=不至食胀酒醉）
单点聚焦：每周只主攻一项美德，其余照常记录不苛责，防止意志力全线崩溃
每晚打点：固定时间自检，过失落入对应格子，形成可视化的缺陷热力图
周期复盘：十三周一轮后检查黑点趋势，接受无法归零的现实并重设优先级
process_en: Behavioral decomposition: translate each abstract quality into an observable daily act ('temperance' = not eating to dullness or drinking to elevation)
Single-point focus: attack one virtue per week while recording the rest without rebuke, preventing a full-frontal collapse of willpower
Nightly dotting: a fixed-time audit, faults falling into their cells to form a visible heatmap of defects
Cycle review: after thirteen weeks check the black-dot trend, accept the non-zero reality, and reset priorities
representative_cases_zh: 《自传》中美德小册子的原版设计：一周一页、十三列、黑点标记
『节制』列黑点最少、『秩序』列始终未清零，他因此写下著名的自我调侃
为 sailing 归程立的 1726 年《行为条款》：四项承诺包括克己与慎言
把记账方法用于写作：模仿《旁观者》逐句还原并对比，追踪进步
建议朋友用类似表格管理账簿与时间，方法扩散到 Junto 成员
representative_cases_en: The original virtue booklet in the Autobiography: one page per week, thirteen columns, black-dot marks

Self-monitoring in behavioral medicine: food diaries and sleep logs as first-line interventions
Athletes' training logs: quantified daily load and subjective state with periodized review
Creators' publishing rhythm sheets: public commitments and dotting as external accountability

name_zh: 方法论/拆解一流作品再逐件复原，用对比暴露自己的差距
name_en: 方法论/拆解一流作品再逐件复原，用对比暴露自己的差距
category: 方法论/拆解一流作品再逐件复原，用对比暴露自己的差距
modes.domain_zh: 把《旁观者》的文章打散成诗行再还原成散文——与原文并排一比，差距自己现形
modes.domain_en: Break a Spectator essay into verse and reconvert it to prose—place it beside the original and the gap shows itself
modes.definition_zh: 少年富兰克林自学写作的方法是刻意练习的十八世纪版本：他取《旁观者》的满意文章，先记下每句要点，搁置几天，再用自己的语言重写原文；然后与原作并排对比，『发现我的一些缺陷并改正』。他进一步变体：把散文改写成诗（强迫自己扩充词汇）、故意打乱要点顺序数周后重新排序（训练结构感）。深意在于：模仿不是复制而是标定——大师作品是已校准的参照系，还原过程把『我觉得写得不错』的主观感受转换成与基准的客观差异；差距一旦可见，改进就有了坐标。这与音乐中的临摹名曲、编程中的重写经典项目同构。代价：对标单一样本会造成风格锁定（他承认自己一直带着《旁观者》的腔调）。现代对应物：程序员重写经典库、设计师临摹界面、棋手复盘名局。
modes.definition_en: Young Franklin's method of teaching himself to write was an eighteenth-century deliberate practice: taking a Spectator essay he admired, noting the gist of each sentence, laying it aside for days, then rewriting the piece in his own words; placing his version beside the original, he 'discovered some of my faults and corrected them.' He added variants: converting prose into verse (forcing vocabulary growth) and shuffling the order of hints for weeks before re-sorting them (training structural sense). The deeper point: imitation is not copying but calibration—a masterwork is a calibrated reference frame, and reconstruction converts the subjective 'I think mine reads well' into objective deviation from a baseline; once the gap is visible, improvement gains coordinates. It is isomorphic to copying the masters in music, rewriting classic software projects, and replaying famous chess games. The cost: a single exemplar locks style (he admitted he always carried the Spectator's tone). Modern analogues: programmers rewriting classic libraries, designers copying interfaces, players replaying famous games.
modes.source_chapter: 《自传》第一部写作训练章；致其子书信中详述《旁观者》还原练习
modes.key_quote_zh: 与原文并排一放，我立刻看见自己输在哪里——差距不可见时，努力都是盲目的。
modes.key_quote_en: Beside the original I saw at once where I fell short—while the gap stays invisible, all effort is blind.
process_zh: 选准基准：挑一件公认一流且可完整还原的作品（文章、代码、棋局）
拆散重写：记录结构要点后完全脱离原文重写，禁止边看边抄
并排对比：逐句/逐段与原作并排，标记每一处差距并归因（词汇、结构、节奏）
变体再练：用改写形式（散文转诗、乱序重排）攻击同一作品的不同侧面
process_en: Pick the baseline: choose a work of recognized excellence that can be fully reconstructed (essay, codebase, chess game)
Dismantle and rewrite: after noting structural points, rewrite entirely away from the original—no copying alongside
Compare side by side: line by line, mark each deviation and attribute it (diction, structure, rhythm)
Rehearse variants: attack different facets of the same work through transformations (prose to verse, reshuffled order)
representative_cases_zh: 《旁观者》文章还原练习：记要点-搁置数日-重写-对比，被他称为写作进步的真正起点
散文改诗再还原：词汇量在两轮转换中被强行扩充
打乱要点顺序放数周再重排：训练文章骨架的判断力
把方法用于辩论：模仿苏格拉底式提问法改掉自己的武断句式
《穷理查年鉴》格言的写作明显带着《旁观者》式压缩风格
representative_cases_en: The Spectator reconstruction: notes, days aside, rewrite, compare—by his account the true start of his progress in writing
Prose into verse and back: vocabulary forcibly expanded across two conversions
Shuffling the hints for weeks before re-sorting: training judgment of an essay's skeleton
Carrying the method into debate: imitating Socratic questioning to cure his own dogmatic phrasing
Poor Richard's maxims audibly carrying the Spectator's compressed style
modern_applications_zh: 程序员重写 Redis/Rails 等经典项目的『build-your-own-X』练习

写作训练中的仿写与逐句对比（拆书稿、精读课）

Writing training via imitation and sentence-by-sentence comparison (close-reading courses)
Chess and poker players replaying master games: choose your move first, then compare with the real one
Translators calibrating their drafts by back-translation

name_zh: 方法论/从语言中剥离攻击性，用疑句替代断言换取说服空间
name_en: 方法论/从语言中剥离攻击性，用疑句替代断言换取说服空间
category: 方法论/从语言中剥离攻击性，用疑句替代断言换取说服空间
modes.domain_zh: 『我恐怕不太正确』比『你完全错了』多买到一百个听众——他把谦逊当成谈判杠杆
modes.domain_en: 'I fear I may be wrong' buys a hundred listeners more than 'you are entirely wrong'—he wielded humility as a negotiating lever
modes.definition_zh: 青年富兰克林因争辩过胜而屡屡树敌，他的修正方案是系统性的语言工程：禁用『 certainly』『undoubtedly』等确定词，改用『I conceive』『I apprehend』；把直接反驳改为『在某种情形下他对，但我看这件事是另一种情形』。他在《自传》中写道：这种语调使他和睦，『当人们提出可能被我否决的方案时，我先表示这方案在何种条件下可取』。外交成果印证了方法：他自述一生的公共成功多归功于此。深意在于：说服的瓶颈常不在论据强度而在对方的自我防御——断言激活对抗，疑句保留对方的修正空间；谦逊语调不是道德装饰，而是降低对方认错成本的交易结构。代价：过分弱化立场会被误读为没有立场，失去决断者的信任。现代对应物：谈判学中的『探询式提问』、非暴力沟通、以及顾问行业的 hedging 语言规范。
modes.definition_en: The young Franklin made enemies by loving to argue, and his corrective was systematic language engineering: banning certainty words like 'certainly' and 'undoubtedly' in favor of 'I conceive' and 'I apprehend'; replacing direct rebuttal with 'he is right in some circumstances, but I take this to be another case.' In the Autobiography he wrote that this tone kept him on good terms—when a plan he doubted was proposed, he first stated the conditions under which it was desirable. His diplomatic record confirmed the method: he credited much of his public success to it. The deeper point: the bottleneck of persuasion often lies not in argument strength but in the other party's self-defense—assertion activates opposition, while tentative phrasing preserves room to revise; the humble tone is not moral decoration but a transaction structure lowering the other side's cost of conceding. The cost: an over-softened stance can be misread as having no stance, forfeiting the trust of decision-makers. Modern analogues: inquiry-based questioning in negotiation, nonviolent communication, and hedging norms in advisory professions.
modes.source_chapter: 《自传》第一部论争辩与语调章；Socratic method 自述；外交书信中的说服策略
modes.key_quote_zh: 我说『恐怕我是错的』，不是说我不自信——是把对方认错的路费先替他付了。
modes.key_quote_en: When I say 'I fear I am wrong,' it is not lack of confidence—it is paying the other side's fare to concede.
process_zh: 清词：清理自己语言中的绝对化词汇（一定、显然、无疑），替换为概率语式
先予后取：反驳前先陈述对方观点成立的条件，使对方卸下防御
问句推进：把关键分歧改写成问题，让对方在回答中自己发现矛盾
留修正空间：以『我目前理解是……若您看到的是另一面我愿修正』收尾，保留双方体面
process_en: Clean the lexicon: purge absolutist words (surely, obviously, undoubtedly), replacing them with probabilistic phrasing
Concede before countering: state the conditions under which the other's view holds before differing, disarming defense
Advance by question: rewrite the key disagreement as a question so the other side finds the contradiction in answering
Leave room to revise: close with 'that is my current understanding—should you see it otherwise, I stand ready to amend,' preserving face on both sides

name_zh: 方法论/把每个不利处境转换成只有该处境才能提供的资源
name_en: 方法论/把每个不利处境转换成只有该处境才能提供的资源
category: 方法论/把每个不利处境转换成只有该处境才能提供的资源
modes.domain_zh: 工人出身买不起书就合伙办图书馆，殖民地远离科学中心就自建学会——他专做『不利条件兑换资源』的生意
modes.domain_en: Too poor for books, he co-founded a library; the colony too far from science, he built its academy—he traded every disadvantage for the resource only that disadvantage could yield
modes.definition_zh: 富兰克林的每次重大创造都始于一个被同行视为劣势的条件：穷学徒买不起书——于是办成北美第一座订阅图书馆（劣势=对共享的刚性需求）；殖民地远离伦敦巴黎的科学中心、无人资助——于是自建哲学会与问题清单（距离=必须本地自组织）；印刷商被邮政系统刁难——于是争取邮政总长职位把物流变成自己的信息网络（被排挤=发现系统命门）。他晚年总结：『我一生中的好运，多半是把别人放弃的处境接手经营。』深意在于：劣势往往内含着未被定价的资源——共享需求、自组织动力、系统盲区；在优势者的框架里这些是负债，换一个框架即可完成套利。代价：套利需要重组成本，机会窗口短。现代对应物：边缘市场的反向创新、创业公司以『没有 legacy 系统』为武器、以及个人职业中的差异化定位。
modes.definition_en: Every major creation of Franklin's began in a condition peers called a disadvantage: a poor apprentice who could not buy books—so he founded North America's first subscription library (disadvantage = rigid demand for sharing); colonies remote from the scientific centers of London and Paris with no patronage—so he built the APS and its question list himself (distance = the necessity of local self-organization); a printer harassed by the postal system—so he won the postmastership and turned logistics into his own information network (exclusion = discovery of the system's choke point). He summed up late in life: 'most of the good fortune of my life came from taking over situations others had abandoned.' The deeper point: disadvantages often embed unpriced resources—shared demand, self-organizing energy, system blind spots; inside the advantaged player's frame these are liabilities, but reframing completes the arbitrage. The cost: arbitrage carries reorganization cost, and the window is short. Modern analogues: reverse innovation from fringe markets, startups wielding 'no legacy systems' as a weapon, and differentiated positioning in personal careers.
modes.source_chapter: 《自传》从学徒到图书馆公司各章；邮政总长任内书信；《穷理查年鉴》财富与逆境格言
modes.key_quote_zh: 别人眼中的穷山恶水，我看见的是没人抢占的空地——劣势就是没人定价的资源。
modes.key_quote_en: Where others saw barren ground, I saw land no one had claimed—a disadvantage is a resource no one has priced.
process_zh: 重新定价：列出当前劣势，为每一项追问『这种处境下什么需求被放大了』
对接组织：把放大的需求转成组织形态（共享图书馆、互助会、自建学会）
捕获命门：在被迫与系统博弈时识别其关键节点（邮政、渠道、规则），争取接管
快速变现：趁优势者尚未回流，把套利成果固化为制度或资产
process_en: Reprice: list current disadvantages and ask of each 'what demand does this condition amplify?'
Attach organization: convert amplified demand into organizational form (a shared library, mutual society, homegrown academy)
Capture the choke point: when forced to fight the system, identify its key nodes (post, channels, rules) and seek to take them over
